#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""The build flag X0X_DEV_PADCAL (BEHAVIOR.md CLP-79): 1 = dev build with the pad calibration, 0 = release.

The test keeps the pad calibration module. It checks the flag itself:
- app/x0x.h makes 1 the default, and tools/build.py passes X0X_DEV_PADCAL=0 or 1 from the environment.
- With 0, the source after the #if X0X_DEV_PADCAL blocks (a small preprocessor that only knows this flag)
  has no pad calibration code in main_fm1.c, ui.c and plat_fm1.c: no padcal name, no "PAD COLOURS",
  no "pad 1 top-left?", no apc40_pad_gamma.h. INLOG args 2-5 then go to the entries reply, as before CLP-79.
- With 1, the same files keep all of it (the padcal tests run on this form).
The Elite builds of both flags: BUILDING.md (nm and strings, in the commit report)."""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC = ROOT / "firmware/src/app"
fails = 0


def check(ok, what):
    global fails
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} {what}")
    fails += not ok


def strip(text, flag):
    """Keep the lines that the build keeps for X0X_DEV_PADCAL=flag (other conditions: both branches)."""
    out, stack = [], []          # stack: (ours, this branch on)
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        s = line.strip()
        m = re.match(r"#\s*(if|ifdef|ifndef|elif|else|endif)\b(.*)", s)
        if m:
            kw, cond = m.group(1), re.sub(r"/\*.*?(\*/|$)|//.*", "", m.group(2))
            if kw in ("if", "ifdef", "ifndef"):
                ours = "X0X_DEV_PADCAL" in cond and kw == "if"
                on = True
                if ours:
                    on = bool(eval(re.sub(r"\w+", lambda w: str(flag) if w.group(0) == "X0X_DEV_PADCAL" else "1",
                                          cond).replace("&&", " and ").replace("||", " or ").replace("!", " not ")))
                stack.append((ours, on))
            elif kw == "else" and stack:
                ours, on = stack[-1]
                stack[-1] = (ours, (not on) if ours else True)
            elif kw == "endif" and stack:
                stack.pop()
            continue
        if all(on for _, on in stack):
            out.append(line)
    return "\n".join(out)


x0x_h = (SRC / "x0x.h").read_text()
build = (ROOT / "tools/build.py").read_text()
check(re.search(r"#ifndef X0X_DEV_PADCAL[^\n]*\n#define X0X_DEV_PADCAL 1\b", x0x_h) is not None,
      "app/x0x.h: the default is 1 (dev build)")
check('"X0X_DEV_PADCAL")' in build and 'flags.append(f"-D{flag}={v}")' in build,
      "tools/build.py: X0X_DEV_PADCAL=0 or 1 from the environment goes to the compiler")

building = (ROOT / "BUILDING.md").read_text()
check("X0X_DEV_PADCAL=0 MODEL=elite ./build.sh --board smk37" in building and "`X0X_DEV_PADCAL=1`" in building
      and "padcal-v1" in building, "BUILDING.md: the release build command, the dev value and the tag padcal-v1")
pad_h = (SRC / "apc40_pad_default.h").read_text()
owner_h = " ".join((SRC / "apc40_pad_owner.h").read_text().replace("*", " ").split())
check("--pad-name APC40_PAD_OWNER writes the live pad table" in " ".join(pad_h.replace("*", " ").split()) and
      "in the dev and the release build" in owner_h,
      "app/apc40_pad_owner.h (generated): the owner-calibrated pad table is the pad table of both builds")
BAD = re.compile(r"padcal|PAD COLOURS|pad 1 top-left|apc40_pad_gamma|apc40_pad_names|ACT_PADCAL|BOOST X|REAL LEVEL", re.I)
for name in ("main_fm1.c", "ui.c", "plat_fm1.c"):
    text = (SRC / name).read_text()
    rel = strip(text, 0)
    left = [ln.strip()[:80] for ln in rel.split("\n") if BAD.search(ln) and not ln.strip().startswith(("/*", "*"))]
    inc = [ln for ln in rel.split("\n") if ln.startswith("#include") and BAD.search(ln)]
    left += inc
    check(not left, f"{name}, flag 0: no pad calibration code ({left[:3]})")
    dev = "\n".join(ln for ln in strip(text, 1).split("\n") if not ln.strip().startswith("#"))
    code = "\n".join(ln for ln in text.split("\n") if not ln.strip().startswith("#"))
    check(len(BAD.findall(dev)) == len(BAD.findall(code)), f"{name}, flag 1: all the pad calibration code stays")
rel = strip((SRC / "main_fm1.c").read_text(), 0)
body = rel[rel.index("static void smk_inlog_reply(uint32_t arg)"):]
body = body[:body.index("\n}\n")]
check("arg - 2u" not in body and "if (arg == 1u)" in body,
      "main_fm1.c, flag 0: INLOG has args 0 and 1 only (args 2-5 get the entries reply)")
ui0 = strip((SRC / "ui.c").read_text(), 0)
check("if (smk_clip_mode_on())\n        return;" in ui0, "ui.c, flag 0: key_event keeps the clip mode guard")
pl0 = strip((SRC / "plat_fm1.c").read_text(), 0)
check("if (smk_ck_knobs_owned())\n        return 0;" in pl0 and "uint8_t clip_mode = smk_clip_mode_on();" in pl0,
      "plat_fm1.c, flag 0: the clip mode knob and button paths stay")
if fails:
    print(f"padcal_flag_test: {fails} FAIL")
    sys.exit(1)
print("padcal_flag_test: ok")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Exact-source BREAK high-rate fractional-tempo continuity host regression.

The original, already-source-pinned fast-advance harness is copied into a temporary
location and changed *only* to exercise fractional playback increments, long
non-power-of-two samples and one live clock-tempo transition. Both variants compile
from the same pinned production breaks.c via BRK_FAST_REV_SKIP=0|1. No firmware
build, hardware-XRUN assertion, MIDI router, device or recorded samples.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

EXPECTED = {
    "firmware/src/dsp/breaks.c": "9e1e607e2ddc3028383bfb6ebc85fbc7ac6864c5",
    "firmware/src/dsp/breaks.h": "6cb71d336c2c90fdc60a9594c2356f3a4379c264",
    "tests/host/breaks_reverse_fast_advance_test.c": "5e77b152253422d36ab7218669187d02318d21cb",
    "tests/host/run_breaks_reverse_fast_advance.py": "eec018339f607283dddc651c74b8d8eb5bfdd948",
    "firmware/src/dsp/ima_adpcm.h": "9ba16e4fe9f0cb643c95a68d540042ab2581d4de",
    "firmware/src/dsp/fastmath.h": "7d2e41bf70590bafa8af0a7376bb912bf763b098",
    "firmware/src/dsp/x0x_param.h": "f7c9bf22b0606946905790dc20497a2e4b2cb4a6",
    "firmware/src/seq/pattern.h": "9a0703418aae95b14f1b70905cfac916da38d7dd",
}
SIZES_OLD = "const uint32_t sizes[]={64,65,255,4097,176400};"
SIZES_NEW = "const uint32_t sizes[]={65,257,4097,176400,2116800};"
STEP_OLD = "float sp16=((float)n/32.0f)/(float)speed;"
STEP_NEW = "float sp16=((float)n/32.0f)/((float)speed + (trial ? 0.875f : 0.125f));"
TEMPO_BEFORE = "        uint64_t prior=x0x_host_ima_decode_calls;"
TEMPO_AFTER = ("        /* Mimic a live clock tempo change while two fading voices may exist. */\n"
               "        if(trial == 1 && j == BLOCKS / 2)\n"
               "            breaks_step(b,0,0,sp16*1.125f,1);\n"
               + TEMPO_BEFORE)
SUMMARY_OLD = "for n in (64, 65, 255, 4097, 176400):"
SUMMARY_NEW = "for n in (65, 257, 4097, 176400, 2116800):"


def git_blob(data):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()


def replace_exact(data, prior, after, path):
    if data.count(prior) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"exact harness edit no longer supported in {path}")
    return data.replace(prior, after)


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--source-root", type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--compiler", choices=["gcc", "clang", "both"], default="both")
    p.add_argument("--sanitizer", action="store_true")
    args = p.parse_args()
    root = args.source_root.resolve()
    source_ids = {}
    for rel, expected in EXPECTED.items():
        actual = git_blob((root / rel).read_bytes())
        if actual != expected:
            raise ValueError(f"wrong Git source {rel}: {actual} != {expected}")
        source_ids[rel] = actual
    if args.output_dir.exists():
        p.error("output directory already exists")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="x0x-break-fraction-", dir="/tmp") as td:
        scratch = Path(td)
        old = (root / "tests/host/breaks_reverse_fast_advance_test.c").read_text()
        changed = replace_exact(old, SIZES_OLD, SIZES_NEW, "sizes")
        changed = replace_exact(changed, STEP_OLD, STEP_NEW, "fractional rate")
        changed = replace_exact(changed, TEMPO_BEFORE, TEMPO_AFTER, "live tempo change")
        (scratch / "breaks_reverse_fast_advance_test.c").write_text(changed)
        runner = (root / "tests/host/run_breaks_reverse_fast_advance.py").read_text()
        runner = replace_exact(runner, SUMMARY_OLD, SUMMARY_NEW, "result categories")
        fn = scratch / "fractional_inner.py"
        fn.write_text(runner)
        cmd = [sys.executable, "-B", str(fn), "--source-root", str(root),
               "--output-dir", str(args.output_dir), "--compiler", args.compiler]
        if args.sanitizer:
            cmd.append("--sanitizer")
        actual = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
        if not args.output_dir.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"inner regression failed before output: {actual.stderr}")
        (args.output_dir / "fractional-runner-stdout.txt").write_text(actual.stdout)
        (args.output_dir / "fractional-runner-stderr.txt").write_text(actual.stderr)
        if actual.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(f"fractional native regression returned {actual.returncode}: {actual.stderr[-1800:]}")
        observed = json.loads((args.output_dir / "result.json").read_text())
        for comp in (["gcc", "clang"] if args.compiler == "both" else [args.compiler]):
            if len(observed[comp]) != 5 * 2 * 7:
                raise RuntimeError(f"wrong scenario matrix for {comp}")
            for row in observed[comp]:
                if row["n"] == 2116800 and row["direction"] == "R" and row["rate"] >= 32:
                    if row["fast-path_decode_calls"] > row["baseline_decode_calls"]:
                        raise RuntimeError(f"decoder work increased for long fast reverse: {row}")
        stamp = {
            "stage": "HOST_FRACTIONAL_TEMPO_SOURCE_EXACT_NOT_TARGET_BUILD_OR_QA",
            "compiled_source_head": "6db88ba43fe0f142f192711142af7726981940d0",
            "git_blobs": source_ids,
            "method": "fractional 1/8 and 7/8 playback-rate offsets; 7/8 trial changes clock tempo 12.5% mid-render; long, non-power-of-two, crossfade/NoteOff and STOP",
            "run_command": cmd,
            "run_exit": actual.returncode,
            "sanitizer": args.sanitizer,
            "compiler": args.compiler,
            "matched_cases_per_compiler": 140,
            "log_sha256": hashlib.sha256(actual.stdout.encode()).hexdigest(),
            "pcm_sha256": {cc: observed["raw_pcm_trace"][cc]["fast-path"]["sha256"]
                            for cc in (["gcc", "clang"] if args.compiler == "both" else [args.compiler])},
            "results": {cc: [x for x in observed[cc] if x["n"] == 2116800 and x["direction"] == "R"]
                        for cc in (["gcc", "clang"] if args.compiler == "both" else [args.compiler])},
        }
        (args.output_dir / "fractional-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(stamp, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        print(actual.stdout.strip())
        print("PASS fractional inc + mid-render tempo change, original-vs-fast PCM bit-equal")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, KeyError) as exc:
        print(f"FAIL: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""The nightly header cache matches a fresh generate and skips the slow rebuild."""
import os
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
os.environ["X0X_GEN_CACHE"] = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="x0x-gen-cache-")
os.environ.pop("X0X_BREAK_BANK", None)
os.environ.pop("X0X_FONTSET", None)
os.environ.pop("X0X_FONT_DIRS", None)

import build  # noqa: E402
import gen_cache  # noqa: E402


def timed(dest):
    build.GEN = Path(dest)
    if build.GEN.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(build.GEN)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    build.generate()
    return time.perf_counter() - started


def main():
    work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="x0x-gen-work-"))
    cold_dir = work / "cold"
    cold = timed(cold_dir)
    warm_dir = work / "warm"
    warm = timed(warm_dir)
    for name in gen_cache.HEADERS:
        cold_bytes = (cold_dir / name).read_bytes()
        warm_bytes = (warm_dir / name).read_bytes()
        if not cold_bytes or cold_bytes != warm_bytes:
            raise SystemExit(f"{name}: cached header does not match a fresh generate")
    print(f"gen-cache cold {cold:.3f}s warm {warm:.3f}s")
    if not warm * 3 < cold:
        raise SystemExit(f"cached generate was not faster: cold {cold:.3f}s warm {warm:.3f}s")

    cached = Path(os.environ["X0X_GEN_CACHE"]) / gen_cache.fingerprint()
    (cached / "felucca_font.h").write_bytes(b"damaged")
    if gen_cache.restore(work / "damaged"):
        raise SystemExit("a damaged cache entry was reused")

    os.environ["X0X_FONTSET"] = "terminus"
    other = work / "terminus"
    timed(other)
    if (other / "felucca_font.h").read_bytes() == (cold_dir / "felucca_font.h").read_bytes():
        raise SystemExit("font set change reused the previous header")
    print("PASS gen cache")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# Compare SMC Record lamps with real panel/SMC-selected recording destinations.
# No target build or hardware access. SMC_SOURCE selects the negative-control source.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
OUT=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$OUT"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
U="firmware/src/dsp/drum909.c firmware/src/dsp/drum808.c firmware/src/dsp/x0x_param.c firmware/src/dsp/bass303.c firmware/src/dsp/breaks.c
firmware/src/dsp/fxbus.c firmware/src/dsp/master.c firmware/src/seq/sequencer.c firmware/src/seq/tb3po.c
firmware/src/seq/pattern.c firmware/src/seq/motion.c firmware/src/app/engine.c"
X0X_HOST_OUT="$OUT/host" sh host/build_host.sh --generate-only > "$OUT/build.log" 2>&1 || { cat "$OUT/build.log"; exit 1; }

    -DX0X_HOST ${X0X_HOST_DEFS:-} -Ifirmware/src -Ifirmware/src/app -Ifirmware/src/dsp -Ibuild/gen \
    "-DSMC_MIXER_SOURCE=\"${SMC_SOURCE:-app/smc_mixer.c}\"" \
    tests/host/smc_record_feedback_test.c $U -lm -o "$OUT/probe"
"$OUT/probe"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""The clip stage page lists selectable settings and depicts keys as playable notes."""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
main = (ROOT / "firmware/src/app/main_fm1.c").read_text()
header = (ROOT / "firmware/src/app/smk_clip_keys.h").read_text()
d0 = main.index("static void ck_page_draw(void)\n{")
pd = main[d0:main.index("\n}\n", d0)]
p0 = main.index("uint8_t smk_ck_panel(uint32_t *last, uint32_t force)")
panel = main[p0:main.index("\n}\n", p0)]
fails = 0


def check(ok, msg):
    global fails
    fails += not ok
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + msg)


check("CK_PAGE_FIELDS[pg][n]" in pd and "CK_E_ON" in header and "ck_get(f)" in pd,
      "page draws its selectable fields, including ON")
check("rbox(fx - 2, fy" in pd and "f == (uint32_t)cp->pg >> 4" in pd,
      "page marks the selected field")
check("ck_zones" not in pd and "CK_ZONE" not in header and "k - lo == v" not in pd,
      "page does not show editable key zones or value keys")
check('"PLAY KEYS"' in pd and "CK_BIT(cp->keys, k) ? c" in pd and
      "ck_kbd(10, 76, 10, 46, CK_NKEY, col)" in pd,
      "page labels its keyboard as playable and lights held keys")
check("ck_nm(CK_MODE_N, i)" in panel and "cp->on >> i & 1u" in panel,
      "KEYS strip retains stage names and ON state")
check("KNOB2 FIELD  KNOB3 / < > VALUE  KEYS PLAY" in pd,
      "help line names the knob and arrow controls")
field = re.search(r"fy = (\d+) \+ \(int32_t\)\(n % 5u\) \* (\d+)", pd)
label = re.search(r"vc\(&FONT_T, (\d+), 10\), &FONT_T, \"PLAY KEYS\"", pd)
help_y = re.search(r"vc\(&FONT_T, (\d+), 12\), &FONT_T, \"KNOB2", pd)
check(bool(field and label and help_y) and int(field.group(1)) + 4 * int(field.group(2)) + 12 <= int(label.group(1))
      and int(label.group(1)) + 10 <= 76 and 76 + 46 <= int(help_y.group(1)) and int(help_y.group(1)) + 12 <= 138,
      "fields, keyboard label, keyboard and help line do not overlap")
print(f"smk_ck_page_layout_test: {fails} fail(s)")
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
